title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Public Sector/National Security
description: PLEASE NOTE: Due to federal contract requirements and client site access obligations, U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a U. S. government secret clearance are required to access classified information. Candidates with an active Secret or higher clearance are strongly encouraged to apply. About Databricks: At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers and deeply customer-obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve hard technical challenges, from designing modern application interfaces to architecting highly available, distributed systems at massive scale. And we're only getting started. The Role: As a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will work with federal government customers to build and productionize solutions to their complex software, data, and AI challenge s using the Databricks platform. You will own the software architecture, lead system design decisions, and implement end-to-end applications spanning backend infrastructure, API integration, and AI-powered product development. We work cross-functional ly to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating deeply with client codebases, systems, and technical teams to help customers build robust applications and get the most value out of their data. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of software engineering and business impact. The ideal candidate combines deep backend or full-stack engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to ship high-quality software projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy. Please note: this role is hybrid and has a requirement to travel to customer locations 20-25% of the time. The impact you will have: Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade software systems. Design and build robust reference architectures, custom enterprise applications, scalable APIs, and seamless integrations with AI/ML models. Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational software projects, including the end-to-end design, build, and deployment of industry-leading, data-intensive and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer. Empower Customers: Guide customers on software architecture and system design; bootstrap or implement core application components, leading to a customer's successful understanding, evaluation, and adoption of Databricks as a developer platform. Own the Architecture: Lead software architecture and system design decisions, ensuring applications are secure, highly available, scalable, and aligned with both modern software engineering standards and Databricks best practices. Deliver Technical Components: Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer engineering teams to ensure the software components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs. Cross-Collaborate: Work directly with Databricks Core Engineering and Customer Support to provide product, API, and implementation feedback, guiding rapid resolution for engagement-specific developer issues. Customer Immersion: Embed with customer engineering teams, engaging with stakeholders from individual contributor SWEs to technical executives to deeply understand software challenges and deliver code-level impact. Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute code accelerators, development frameworks, open-source libraries, and engineering best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks developer experience roadmap. What We're Looking For: Minimum Qualifications: 6+ years of experience in software engineering, backend development, or distributed systems engineering. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent relevant years of experience in an Engineering function. Advanced proficiency writing production code in Python, Scala, Java, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern application frameworks. Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one. Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code for production deployments. Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs. Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end software architectures and applications that combine backend s ervices, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces. Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex business requirements into actionable software s olutions. Strong technical documentation and system white-boarding skills (e.g., sequence diagrams, architecture flows). Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range. Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new development tools and frameworks which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
